integrity: State, observables, moments, counterexample, qubit proof and full-rank extension are explicit; SymPy verification is computational corroboration, not a substitute for proof. Literature priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact d=3 counterexample and universal d=2 protection; no claim on the optimal violation magnitude, higher-dimensional maxima, Pearson product conjecture or entropic correlation bounds. One highly relevant later primary paper on different correlation functionals was not available in full text.
title: A sharp qutrit failure of the two-basis Pearson separability criterion
